defect: CODING_FAILED after planner exhausted retries (implementation_plan.json never written)
root_cause: getModelContextWindow('glm/glm-5') did not strip the router 'provider/' prefix before searching ALL_AVAILABLE_MODELS (which stores bare 'glm-5'), so it silently fell through to the 200,000-token conservative default instead of GLM-5's real 128,000-token window. The 70%/90% compaction warning and hard-abort guards in session/runner.ts:496-524 therefore never fired at the real limit. The planner burned its ENTIRE real context (reached 318,158 prompt tokens = 159.1% of the WRONG 200k denominator, i.e. 248.6% of the REAL 128k window) across 3 full re-plan attempts without ever calling Write on implementation_plan.json, so validateAndNormalizeJsonFile() correctly reported File not found and build-orchestrator.ts:402-406 failed the task after MAX_PLANNING_VALIDATION_RETRIES=3.
fix_summary: After the direct-value lookup fails, strip everything before the first '/' and retry the lookup against the unprefixed id before falling through to DEFAULT_MODEL_EQUIVALENCES search and the 200k default.

proof.method: real code path via npx tsx, NOT a mock/stub
proof.before_fix_measured: live run: 318158 prompt tokens / 200000 (wrong fallback) = 159.08% (matches UI's displayed 159.1%)
proof.note: opus and unmatched ids still correctly fall back to 200000 -- no regression
